purpose: Locate actual geometry/material disagreements, not accept road centerline connectivity
method: Exact barycentric triangle height/plane gradient. Sample final NPZ occupancy bilinearly. Path footprint means largest of grass/rock/path/soil/sand before shader edge sharpening. The 30/45 degree bins only locate candidate visual problems, not legal/walkability/visual pass criteria.
route_envelope_note: 21 lateral samples span +/-1.25 nominal route halfwidth, at <=.12m stations; clinic uses .70m override. Scope outside the 3 road23 rectangles still uses G23 old width fields. Region scans measure actual path-leading area independently of nominal routes.

tight_control_bends.note: A local three-control-point curvature indicator. These are distance-band centerlines, not a promise that the physical ground was shaped to this bend.

limitations: No occlusion culling: region scans include ground under buildings; use screenshot and coordinates before treating a location as visibly exposed.
Shader grass-edge perturbation and texture bump do not change triangle heights; measured weights are upstream occupancy, not reconstructed screenshot colors.
No conclusion that every steep path point is wrong: steps, short banks and actual visible route purpose require visual interpretation.
